pages.text: On a summer night, Mom spread a mat in the yard. "There will be lots of shooting stars tonight."
Lulu lay down. "I will see a shooting star for sure."
Uncle Nino lay beside Lulu. "Shooting stars? They fall when I whistle. I saw ten in my day."
He whistled and whistled. The sky stayed quiet.
Lulu watched the sky with wide eyes. The cousins yawned, one by one.
Lulu pulled the blanket up to the chin and waited patiently.
Whoosh! A star drew a long line across the sky. "I saw it!" Lulu called.
Uncle Nino sat straight up. "Me too! That one just now, right?" The mat had left marks on his cheek.
